whoami.name: whoami
whoami.description: Answer questions to find out which character from Greek mythology you are.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.description: The king of the gods, master of the sky and thunder.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.description: The god of the sea, capable of causing storms and earthquakes.

hera.name: Hera
hera.description: The queen of the gods, wife of Zeus and protector of marriage.

hades.name: Hades
hades.description: The god of the underworld, guardian of souls and ruler of death.

athena.name: Athena
athena.description: The goddess of wisdom, warfare strategy, and crafts.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.description: The god of the sun, music, and prophecy.

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.description: The goddess of the hunt, wilderness, and wild animals.

ares.name: Ares
ares.description: The god of war, representing violence and conflict.

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite.description: The goddess of love, beauty, and desire.

hephaestus.name: Hephaestus
hephaestus.description: The god of fire, metalworking, and crafts.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.description: The god of travelers, messengers, and thieves.

dionysus.name: Dionysus
dionysus.description: The god of wine, festivity, and joy.

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.description: The goddess of agriculture, nature, and the harvest.

questions.conflict: A conflict breaks out in your friend group. How do you react?
questions.ideal_space: What is your ideal workspace or living area?
questions.ambiguous_task: You are given an important mission with very few instructions. What do you do?
questions.support: When faced with someone who is struggling or in distress:
questions.unexpected_obstacle: What is your strategy when facing an unexpected obstacle?
questions.social_event: At a party or social gathering:
questions.daily_expression: How do you express your personality in daily life?
questions.greatest_strength: What is your greatest strength according to those close to you?

conflict.a: I take charge immediately and enforce the final decision.
conflict.b: I calmly analyze the facts to offer the most rational solution.
conflict.c: I let my anger explode—I need to vent.
conflict.d: I try to lighten the mood with humor and a clever distraction.

ideal_space.a: An isolated, quiet place where nobody disturbs me.
ideal_space.b: A lively spot surrounded by people, music, and activity.
ideal_space.c: An ultra-organized, functional space where everything has its place.
ideal_space.d: A creative studio or workshop filled with ongoing projects.

ambiguous_task.a: I improvise on the spot based on my intuition.
ambiguous_task.b: I set up a rigorous strategic plan before laying the first brick.
ambiguous_task.c: I ask for the group's input so we can move forward together.
ambiguous_task.d: I handle it on my own, my way, without answering to anyone.

support.a: I take them under my wing and protect them at all costs.
support.b: I give them logical advice so they can solve the problem themselves.
support.c: It makes me uncomfortable; I prefer to keep my distance.
support.d: I use clever tricks or my contacts to solve their problem behind the scenes.

unexpected_obstacle.b: Find a creative workaround or a loophole in the system.
unexpected_obstacle.c: Coldly reassess the situation and adjust my approach.
unexpected_obstacle.d: Stand my ground and wait for the obstacle to give way.

social_event.a: I am the center of attention and the life of the party.
social_event.b: I stay with a few close friends to make sure everyone is doing well.
social_event.c: I prefer to observe from a quiet corner.
social_event.d: I like to throw out playful challenges or tease people.

daily_expression.a: Through art, style, music, or writing.
daily_expression.b: Through my achievements, my position, and my successes.
daily_expression.c: Through my sense of justice and fairness.
daily_expression.d: Through my humor, my stories, and my boldness.

greatest_strength.a: Your loyalty and your ability to care for others.
greatest_strength.c: Your boundless energy and limitless boldness.
